findings.failure_scenario: If progress_pending_merge ever contains a row with `legacyRepeat` (or another future per-row XP marker), the `foldPendingProgress` merge re-scores that row with `answerXp()` directly instead of routing through `applyAnswer()`. `answerXp()` does not honor `legacyRepeat`, so the credit that was deliberately suppressed could be paid again, and ability would be updated when the original answer did not update it. Pre-PR snapshots lack that field, so this path is likely not reachable today, but the parked-merge machinery is now the general conflict path and should keep the same scoring entry point as live answers.
findings.fix: Route each new row through `applyAnswer` or filter out `legacyRepeat` rows before the direct XP/ability replay.
findings.title: foldPendingProgress does not use applyAnswer

findings.failure_scenario: The guest save screen says “{sum.xp} of {next.xp} XP toward Graduate Nurse” as the sole progress indicator, but the next rank also requires 20 answered questions. A guest with 5 answers and, say, 80 XP from difficulty 3 items would be told they are at the XP threshold while the real gate still needs 15 more answers. This is user-facing copy that the code does not make true.
findings.fix: Mention the answer-count requirement and show both metrics (e.g., “{sum.xp} of {next.xp} XP and {sum.n} of 20 answers”).
findings.problem: SaveProgress next-rank copy omits non-XP requirements.
findings.title: Guest save screen overstates rank progress

findings.failure_scenario: The `AuthGate` `forgetTrial` callback clears `pulsern-guest-v1` on every `SIGNED_OUT` event, including a supabase token refresh sign-out (e.g., a forced re-login from another tab or an OAuth callback). If a student was in the middle of the guest trial and a transient `SIGNED_OUT` event fires before sign-in completes, the device trial is deleted. The one-time forced re-login already clears the key intentionally when a session exists, but this broad handler triggers on every `SIGNED_OUT` even when no user-initiated sign-out occurred.
findings.fix: Only clear the guest trial on user-initiated sign-out paths (`signOutAndForgetTrial` and the forced re-login), or distinguish a remote-session drop from an intentional sign-out before deleting.
findings.problem: Overly broad guest-trial clearing on all SIGNED_OUT events.
findings.title: SIGNED_OUT handler may delete an active trial

Text pass: The change is large and mostly covered by extensive tests. I found no clear blocker in the scoring/readiness math, the revision guard, the question identity migration, or the guest trial handoff. The items below are lower-confidence maintainability/correctness concerns in paths I could not fully verify against the full browser scenarios.
